name: io.github.wulfkaal/kaal-corpus
title: Kaal Corpus
description: Read-only access to the published corpus of Prof. Wulf A. Kaal: 5,482 atomic claims from 136 claim-covered works, 2004-2026. Each claim carries a source quote and the sha256 of its source PDF. Single-author corpus; reports coverage, asserts no ranking.
